items.title: Approval of the Minutes of October 10, 2023
Report on Recent San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Activities, Events and Announcements
items.text: Report on Recent San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Activities, Events and Announcements General Manager (GM) Herrera announced the passing of former SFPUC Deputy General Manager Tony Irons, and former Deputy City Attorney Donn Furman. He highlighted their distinguished careers and contributions to the City and County of San Francisco. Commissioner Stacy discussed her working relationship with Mr. Furman and his important work at the City Attorney’s Office. She noted his love of the outdoors. She discussed Mr. Iron’s commitment to public service and honored his contributions to the city

items.title: Approve the Revised Water Supply Assessment for the proposed 3251 20th Avenue (Stonestown) Project
items.text: Approve the Revised Water Supply Assessment for the proposed 3251 20th Avenue (Stonestown) Project, pursuant to the State of California Water Code Section 10910, et seq., California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Section 21151.9, and CEQA Guidelines Section 15155. Steve Ritchie, Assistant General Manager (AGM) Water Enterprise indicated the staff request is for approval of a revised Water Supply Assessment (WSA) for the 3251 20th Avenue (Stonestown) Project due to (1) a change in the project variance; and (2) updates to projected water demands associated with the housing element. He emphasized that the WSA is legally required for determination that water is available for the project and that Commission approval is for the WSA only. Project approval is done by the Planning Commission
